name: ic-research-lab
description: Monorepo de iniciações científicas independentes: peptide-docking (Módulo A) e fog-gnn (Módulo B)

scripts.synthetic: uv run --directory modules/peptide-docking/backend python scripts/make_synthetic_library.py && uv run --directory modules/fog-gnn/backend python scripts/make_synthetic_imu.py
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:a && pnpm run test:b
scripts.lint:python: uv run --directory packages/core ruff check packages/core modules/peptide-docking/backend modules/fog-gnn/backend && uv run --directory packages/core ruff format --check packages/core modules/peptide-docking/backend modules/fog-gnn/backend
scripts.typecheck:python: uv run --directory packages/core mypy src tests && uv run --directory modules/peptide-docking/backend mypy src tests scripts && uv run --directory modules/fog-gnn/backend mypy src tests scripts
